problem: Native modern comment and caption records had basic read coverage, but task/reaction derivative operations and TracksInfo metadata publication remained unverified. The caption set method also incorrectly advertised replacement although its existing implementation creates only new related tracks.
changes: Add four comment/thread tests using the native navigation-review and master-motion decks, including exact eager/source text and identity projection, task-field updates, reply CRUD, author-reference guards and task-history/reaction derivative lifecycle.

Add four caption tests using the native modern-media deck: exact descriptor/cue reads, source-preserving identity/label/language/display edits, optional-language removal/reinsertion, and related WebVTT creation with collision refusals.

Index two more bounded feature rows and strengthen existing modern-comment and caption rows. Clarify native qualification limits in the matrix and correct the caption set API documentation; production behavior is unchanged.

verification_scope.native_comments: Both decks retain the same authored comment/reply GUIDs, author, exact text, local timestamps, text-range moniker (slide 259, shape 3, cp 0, len 52), context hash and position. Their owners differ by physical slide position: navigation slide 4 and master-motion slide 5. Eager/source data and author payloads agree. Tasks, reactions and V2 commands are absent in the native threads.
verification_scope.task_fields: A native thread gains a title containing XML-sensitive characters, an existing-author assignment, dates and 25-percent progress, encoded as complete=25000. Save/reopen exposes those values through eager and source views. Unknown assignee and comment-ID mutation are refused atomically. The original anchor, body and reply text remain exact; every other package member is unchanged.
verification_scope.task_reaction_derivatives: Litchi adds a task-history assignment event tied to the native author/comment and root/reply Unicode reactions with exact UTC timestamps. Updating assignment to 50-percent progress and changing/removing reaction payloads survives save/reopen; malformed author GUID staging is atomic. These are library derivatives using caller-selected extension URIs, not native-authored task/reaction fixtures or verified PowerPoint extensions.
verification_scope.reply_crud: Add a second reply with a new stable GUID, resolve it and remove it. Original ordering and complete original thread semantics are recovered. Referenced author removal is refused without losing the staged reply; no remote collaboration is invoked.
verification_scope.native_captions: Video shape 4 on slide 2 retains rId2 media, rId4 WebVTT and caption GUID 22E87EF0-5BD7-B344-840B-341EC7730D78, English Fixture 007 label, en-us language and media display location. Two exact cues span 0-1000 and 1000-2000 ms. A narration owner is absent.
verification_scope.caption_updates: GUID, escaped label, language and display-location edits change only the intended source attribute values; exact trim/fade XML, WebVTT, media, drawings and all other members survive. Removing/reinserting language keeps valid XML, distinct optional state and inert cue data. Invalid GUID/index and absent narration-owner creation preserve prior staged work.
verification_scope.caption_creation: A derivative related WebVTT part is added under a new relationship ID. The existing text/vtt default requires no content-type changes. Only the new part and owning relationship member change. Existing IDs/part names are refused. This operation does not attach a second caption descriptor or replace the native caption.
verification_scope.inverse_and_container_scope: No-op transactions keep the original archive. Forward/stale replay and inverse are checked. After reopening a saved output, inverse restores every OPC member payload exactly; the edited member is recompressed and its Office-specific ZIP flags/deflate size are not restored. Inspection of the initial overly broad archive-equality assertions found zero changed payloads: comments recompressed from 681 to 685 bytes and slide2 XML from 1516 to 1521 bytes, with ZIP flags 6 becoming 8. Final assertions compare every member, including graph XML, without XML normalization.
verification_scope.limits: No native task/reaction extension specimen, V2-command operation, narration-owner authoring, player events, playback, caption rendering, text-anchor relocation, collaboration execution or fresh PowerPoint reopen is established. The original native files and historical inventory remain immutable.

specification_evidence.finding: The completion field uses positive fixed percentage units; 25 percent is pinned as 25000 in the generated derivative, with matching eager/source projection.

Derivative events retain typed time, GUID, author and comment anchors. Reaction types use Unicode emoji as recommended by the specification, with explicit UTC timestamps and native author IDs. No extension URI recognition by Office is inferred.
